issue.body:
I've recently updated starlette (unsure of which version i came from) to 0.13.4. Now my application will no longer start it simply hangs.

```python
middleware = [
    Middleware(
        CORSMiddleware,
        allow_origins=['http://127.0.0.1:3000', 'http://localhost:3000'],
        allow_methods=['*'],
        allow_headers=['*'],
        allow_credentials=True
    )
]

APP = Starlette(
    debug=True,
    on_startup=[
        GINO.initialize,
        lambda: _logger.logger.info('app init')
    ],
    on_shutdown=[GINO.destroy],
    middleware=middleware
)

APP.mount('/graphql', GRAPHQLAPP)
```

this used to start the app but now the application never logs the startup message it just hangs on `app init`

if I remove the GINO line it still just logs `app init` then hangs.

Once I remove all of the startup functions then the app starts correctly, but this is obviously not a solution.

App is running in a docker container with an untouched dockerfile

`CMD [ "python", "-m", "uvicorn",  "app:APP", "--host", "0.0.0.0", "--port", "5001", "--log-level", "info", "--reload", "--reload-dir", "/app"]`
issue.title: Application Startup Never Completes
